typography.guidelines: Use oversized, expressive serif typography for headings to convey legacy and premium quality. Contrast with geometric sans-serif for body text. Headings must have extremely tight line-height (leading-[0.9] or leading-none) and negative tracking.

colors.guidelines: Parent site is dark and cinematic (Deep Navy and Gold). Trust and Boutique use warm, light themes to convey human connection and elegance. Travels and Tyre use dark, industrial/cinematic themes.

motion_language.preloader: Dark screen with minimal gold outline logo drawing, splitting open vertically.
motion_language.hero_entrance: Split-text reveal (words/characters sliding up from masked overflow hidden div), hero image scaling from 1.15 to 1.0 over 2 seconds with ease-out.
motion_language.scroll_reveals: Staggered fade-up for content blocks (Y: 40px -> 0, Opacity: 0 -> 1) triggered on scroll. Use Framer Motion once: true.
motion_language.horizontal_scroll: Pinned container for venture showcase. As user scrolls vertically, the inner container translates horizontally.
motion_language.micro_interactions: Magnetic effect on major CTAs, custom dot cursor that expands over clickable elements, slow smooth page transitions via AnimatePresence.

layout_principles.structure: Editorial asymmetry. Avoid perfectly centered bootstrap grids. Use overlapping images, text bleeding off-canvas, and massive negative space (py-24, py-32).
layout_principles.grid: 12-column grid. Example: text spans col-span-5, image spans col-span-6 starting from col-start-7.
layout_principles.mobile: Stack cleanly on mobile. Remove horizontal scroll on mobile (convert to vertical list). Restrict image heights to max-h-[80vh].

component_path.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea for EmailJS forms. Strip default styling to match cinematic dark or light mode.
component_path.galleries: Custom Framer Motion masonry or bento grids with lightbox functionality.
component_path.buttons: Custom magnetic buttons with animated borders and hover fills, rather than default Shadcn buttons.

accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: disable parallax, replace horizontal scroll with simple fade-ins.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text over images by using robust gradients/scrims (bg-black/40).
accessibility.testing: All CTAs, forms, and venture links MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute a full visual overhaul to Awwwards-level cinematic standard. The project is static (React + Tailwind + Framer Motion). Content remains identical; your job is strictly visual orchestration. Heavily rely on 'Cormorant Garamond' for headings to establish an editorial legacy tone. Leverage Framer Motion for scroll-driven storytelling: split-text reveals, subtle parallax, and horizontal scrolling for the ventures showcase. Make use of 'lenis' for smooth scrolling. Implement custom styling instead of default Shadcn for layout elements to achieve an editorial broken-grid look. Keep mobile performant by stripping intense WebGL/parallax effects on small viewports.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align the app container. Create depth with z-index and overlays. Use glass-morphism sparingly and precisely (not everywhere). Do not use AI emojis. Implement micro-animations on all interactive elements. All CTAs and navigation elements must carry data-testid. Use generous spacing (py-24, py-32). NEVER use placeholder URLs for images; strictly map the provided image_urls to their respective categories.

tone_tokens.spacing_system: Use wide gaps (gap-12 to gap-24) and large vertical padding (py-32 for standard sections).

motion_language.hero_entrance: Staggered text reveal + slow image scale down.
motion_language.scroll_reveals: Fade up and slightly translate Y (40px) on viewport entry.
motion_language.ventures_showcase: Horizontal scroll sequence mapped to vertical scroll progress.

build_manifest.curated_cinematic_images: Image mapping is provided in the image_urls array, covering all specified ventures, founder textures, and hero sections.
